sections.text_helper: Section 22.5.5 "GFXMMU default alpha register (GFXMMU_DAR)" in chapter 22 (Chrom-GRC (GFXMMU)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1077.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0014
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:8 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 7:0 DA[7:0]: Default alpha
This field indicates the default 8-bit value which is merged with the 24-bit value when a
master accesses a virtual memory location in packed mode.
